title: Current Affairs Basics
notes:
How to Follow Current Affairs

  • Track national news: Parliament proceedings, cabinet decisions, budget (published each Jestha), new laws and ordinances.
  • Track international news: UN summits, major elections, climate conferences (COP), and peace processes.
  • Follow sports & awards: Olympics, ICC/World Cup events, Nobel Prizes, national honours (e.g., Nepal's awards and medals).
  • For Loksewa exams, current affairs of the last 6–12 months matter most.

Nobel Prize Quick Facts (2025 winners to verify)

Nobel Prizes are awarded in Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace and Economic Sciences, announced each October in Stockholm (and Oslo for Peace).
